name: AI-Powered Freelance Opportunity Aggregator — SKIP Audit

parameters.query:
WITH risky AS (
    SELECT
        e.opportunity_id,
        o.title,
        o.url,
        o.source,
        e.scope_status,
        e.scope_confidence,
        e.scope_reason,
        e.total_score,
        e.summary,
        e.skill_gaps,
        e.semantic_blockers,
        e.uncertainty,
        e.evaluated_at,
        'borderline' AS audit_type
    FROM public.opportunity_ai_evaluations e
    JOIN public.opportunities o
        ON o.id = e.opportunity_id
    WHERE e.evaluation_version = 'v1.8'
      AND e.decision = 'SKIP'
      AND e.evaluated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
      AND (
          e.scope_status = 'in_scope'
          OR e.total_score >= 9
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM jsonb_each(e.semantic_blockers) AS b(key, value)
          WHERE (value->>'blocked')::boolean = true
            AND value->>'confidence' = 'high'
      )
    ORDER BY RANDOM()
    LIMIT 3
),

random_skips AS (
    SELECT
        e.opportunity_id,
        o.title,
        o.url,
        o.source,
        e.scope_status,
        e.scope_confidence,
        e.scope_reason,
        e.total_score,
        e.summary,
        e.skill_gaps,
        e.semantic_blockers,
        e.uncertainty,
        e.evaluated_at,
        'random' AS audit_type
    FROM public.opportunity_ai_evaluations e
    JOIN public.opportunities o
        ON o.id = e.opportunity_id
    WHERE e.evaluation_version = 'v1.8'
      AND e.decision = 'SKIP'
      AND e.evaluated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM risky r
          WHERE r.opportunity_id = e.opportunity_id
      )
    ORDER BY RANDOM()
    LIMIT (
        SELECT GREATEST(0, 5 - COUNT(*))
        FROM risky
    )
)

SELECT * FROM risky
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM random_skips;
